artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan binding a push_branch grant to refs/heads/<ref> at both the mint and match sites, with suite cases for the three acceptance behaviours, one clarifying doc sentence, and a redeploy.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan phase must declare a Verification Tier below `full`, the honest Tier Justification is produced by running suite_selection_select ONCE over that phase's whole Files-to-modify set and naming what it returns -- and the selector's answer can be strictly larger than intuition suggests. For a two-file edit to a consent-grant hook plus its library, the selector returned seven suites (including the destructive-guard and deploy-propagation suites), not the two obviously-named ones; that larger set is itself the argument for `interface` over `local`, because it enumerates the real one-hop dependent set. A markdown-only standards file in the same source store returned __FULL_SWEEP__ (no covering suite), which routes to the verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4 subset with the SOURCE-STORE REPOSITORY ROOT as TARGET -- never the source_dir itself, which has no .claude/ subtree and fails gate0 before gate selection runs.
